Ochwepheshe bezemvelo banxuse amazwe acebile ukuba anciphise ukukhishwa kwentuthu embi esemoyeni ukuze kuvikelwe ikusasa labantwana abazayo nezizukulwane ezizayo.

kwemfundo.corpus_example: Kunezikhalazo ezikhulayo mayelana nokuphazamiseka kwemfundo ngenxa yeziteleka zabasebenzi bomphakathi abafuna amaholo angcono nonyaka. Abafundi baka-matric bazwakalise ukukhathazeka kwabo ngokuthi lokhu kuzophazamisa ukulungiselela kwabo izivivinyo zokuphela konyaka ezinquma ikusasa labo. Umnyango wezeMfundo unxuse izinyunyana ukuba zibuyele etafuleni lezingxoxo kanti zibeke ikusasa labantwana phambili ukuze kube nesisombululo esizosiza wonke umuntu ngaphandle kokubandlulula.

kwemigomo.corpus_example: Impumelelo eqhubekayo idinga ukuvuselelwa kwemigomo kanye nokulungiswa kwezinhlelo uma izimo ziguquka.

kwemihlanu.corpus_example: Leso yisexwayo esikhishwe ngabenhlangano yezempilo emhlabeni i-World Health Organization, lapho beveze khona ukuthi ukuminza kwabasuke bebhukuda ngenye yezizathu ezihamba phambili eziholela ekutheni izingane zife, okufakazelwa wukuthi njalo ngonyaka kushona abantu abangaphezu kwa-300 000 ngenxa yokuminza, ingxenye yabo okuyizingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kwemihlanu okuyizona ezisengcupheni kakhulu.

kwemindeni.corpus_example: Abazali nezihlobo babhala izincwadi zokubonga ezazigcwele uthando, abazishadayo babona ukuthi umshado wabo uwubudlelwane obukhulu phakathi kwemindeni emibili.

kweminye.corpus_example: Isikhulu esiphezulu sesikhungo sezempilo esizimele i-Affinity Health, uMnuz Murray Hewlett, sithe enye ingozi enkulu yalokhu wukuthi kweminye imizi bano-swimming pool emagcekeni, okuba yingozi ngokuthi kwesinye isikhathi uyaminza ubukade ungaqondile, okungaba ngokuthi ushelele ungene emanzini ngenxa yokukhathala nokujabula kuze kweqe.

kwemiphefumulo.corpus_example: Kuleli sonto, amaphoyisa omgwaqo abophe abashayeli abangaphezulu kwamashumi amabili nanhlanu abebe shayela bephuzile endaweni yaseThekwini. Lo mkhankaso obubizwa ngokuthi u-Zero Tolerance uqinisekisile ukuthi wonke umuntu ophula umthetho emigwaqweni uzobhekana nengalo yomthetho ngaphandle kokunqikaza. Uhulumeni unxuse abantu ukuba basebenzise izinto zokuzithutha zomphakathi uma bephumile ukuyozijabulisa ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi eziningi ezidala ukulahleka kwemiphefumulo eminingi emigwaqweni yethu.

kwemizamo.corpus_example: ngemva kwemizamo eminingi, Imindeni yonke bazinza ezweni labo ezihlabelelweni zamasiko ngokuphakama kwabo, ngoba bafuna ukushintja izinto, okwenza abantu babo bathande indawo abahlala kuyo.

kwemizuliswano.corpus_example: ngemva kwemizuliswano emihlanu, Indoda yekhaya basebenzisana kahle nabanye ezindaweni ezidumile ngobuhlakani obukhulu, ngoba baqonda ukubaluleka kwezinto, futhi bafundisa abantwana babo ukubaluleka kwezinto.

kwemvelo.corpus_example: Ukugcinwa kwemvelo yamanzi ahlanzekiyo kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba amanzi ahlanzekiyo yisidingo sokuphila kwabantu nazo zonke izilwane.

kwemvula.corpus_example: Ngisebenzisa ikhompiyutha emsebenzini wami nsuku zonke. Umakhalekhukhwini wami ushayela ucingo futhi uthumela imiyalezo. Ikhompiyutha ingasiza abafundi ekwenzeni ucwaningo. kwengqondo.corpus_example: Lokho kushiwo wuDkt Denis Mutyaba, udokotela weNetcare Unitas Hospital, ePitoli, obhekele izifo eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwengqondo, umgogodla nokunye okweyamene nakho, exwayisa abantu ngokumele bakuqaphele ukuze bagweme umthelela omubi walesi simo, nongaze udale ukuthi uphoqeleke ukuhlinzwa ukuzama ukukwelapha.

kwenkinga.corpus_example: Uthe lona wumsebenzi ongenamicilikisho yesikhathi eside njengoba udinga ukuthi uma usuphothule u-matric, wenze izifundo zeFirst Aid nSafety ukuze ube nolwazi lokuthi umsiza kanjani umuntu osuke edinga usizo oluphuthumayo, bese futhi uba nesicucu esizofakazela ukuthi uzokwazi ukuba semanzini ngaphandle kwenkinga uma kunezimo ezidinga lokho.

kwento.corpus_example: Umlimi ohle onomusa ohlwayela izitshalo emasimini amakhulu uyaphila ngokuhlonipha abanye abantu ngemithetho yobubanzi, ezimisela ukufeza umsebenzi wakhe ngaphambi kwesikhathi esimisiwe, ngenxa yezizathu eziningi ezikhombisa ukubaluleka kwento enkulu.

kwenzeka.corpus_example: Kwenzeka lokhu nje, nango-2024 akubanga kuhle nakubalandeli bomculi waseMzimkhulu, uSolwazi, emuva kokuba iQuantum liwinwe wumculi wasoPhongolo, uGatsheni.

kwenzeke.corpus_example: “Yingakho nemicimbi efuze lona esihlangene ngawo kumqoka ukuhlangana kuyona, bese siyabhunga ngezinto eziyizinselelo ezisimisa ndawonye njengalena, ngethemba ukuthi kukhona okuhle esingaphuma nakho uma sibambisana. kwenziwa.corpus_example: Isolezwe like labika ukuthi iSamro ayisakugunyazi ukuba kudlalwe umculo wamalungu ayo emicimbini ehlanganisa abantu kungekho sivumelwano nabagqugquzeli. Sekudingeka umgqugquzeli womcimbi abathumelele uhlu lwezingoma ezidlaliwe njengoba kwenziwa emsakazweni.

kweqe.corpus_example: Isikhulu esiphezulu sesikhungo sezempilo esizimele i-Affinity Health, uMnuz Murray Hewlett, sithe enye ingozi enkulu yalokhu wukuthi kweminye imizi bano-swimming pool emagcekeni, okuba yingozi ngokuthi kwesinye isikhathi uyaminza ubukade ungaqondile, okungaba ngokuthi ushelele ungene emanzini ngenxa yokukhathala nokujabula kuze kweqe.

kwesikhathi.corpus_example: 1.
